a.text: Being upfront with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of waiting for 8 cells almost certainly leaves us both with empty units. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than doing it silently. If we both take, the split is random and we may both end up short, so I'd suggest you operate or wait. If the storm doesn't come, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
